name: dbus
description: Reference implementation of D-Bus, a message bus system providing a simple way for applications and system services to talk to one another, used for both interprocess communication and coordinated process lifecycle management on Linux.
install: cd dbus-1.16.2 && DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" ninja -C build install
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
